power.greenlantern.heat_vision.desc: Two red beams from your eyes burn whatever you look at: they set creatures on fire, melt ice and snow and light TNT. Lasts a few seconds; use again to stop.
power.greenlantern.super_punch.desc: A punch that hits like thunder: hurts and throws every creature around the impact and knocks projectiles out of the air. Hits harder the faster you fly.
power.greenlantern.super_breath.desc: A freezing gale: pushes and hurts everything in front of you, slows and freezes creatures, turns water into ice and puts out fires. Use again to stop.
power.greenlantern.xray_vision.desc: See through walls: creatures glow, and ores, chests and spawners show up through the stone. Use again to turn it off.

guide.greenlantern.superman.title: Superman
guide.greenlantern.superman:
The Man of Steel arrives: §9Superman§r, the last son of Krypton. His strength comes from the yellow sun.

§6The crystal§r
Craft the §6Kryptonian Crystal§r (amethyst, diamonds, gold and a sunflower). Right-click or press §eG§r to put on the suit: blue with the S shield, red trunks and boots, the yellow belt and the long red cape. One hero at a time: putting on a suit takes the others off.

§6The Man of Steel§r
In the suit you are far stronger (huge punches and a long reach), much tougher (most damage is greatly reduced), faster, you break blocks in a blink, you jump higher, step up blocks, are immune to fire and lava and take no fall damage.

§6Flight§r
§eDouble-tap jump§r to take off, like the Lantern, but faster and more powerful: he breaks the sound barrier sooner (white vapor cone and a thunderous boom) and keeps accelerating far beyond it. Turn sharply and dive into the ground for a landing that shakes everything around.

§6Solar energy§r
The powers and flight run on solar energy (the golden bar). The crystal stores a lot of it and recharges in direct sunlight: out in the open, during the day, under the sky. Rain weakens the sun; high up in the sky it charges faster. Standing in the sun also heals you. While heat vision or super breath is on, the crystal does not charge.
guide.greenlantern.superman_powers.title: Superman's Powers
guide.greenlantern.superman_powers:
In the suit, hold §eR§r for the power menu (tap R for the next one) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the crystal) to use it.

§6Heat Vision§r
Two red beams from the eyes burn what you look at: they set creatures on fire, melt ice and snow, light TNT and set fires. They last a few seconds; use again to stop.

§6Super Punch§r
A thunderclap: every creature around the impact is hurt and thrown far away, and arrows are knocked out of the air. Punch while flying fast and it hits much harder.

§6Super Breath§r
A freezing gale in front of you: pushes and hurts, slows and freezes creatures, turns water into ice and lava into stone, and puts out fires.

§6X-Ray Vision§r
See through everything: creatures nearby glow through the walls and ores, chests and spawners show up in color through the stone. It costs very little; use again to turn it off.
guide.greenlantern.controls_superman:
§eRight-click§r (crystal): put on the suit or use the power.
§eG§r: put on / remove the suit.
§eDouble-tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: accelerate. §eCtrl§r: accelerate faster.
§eA A§r or §eD D§r flying fast: barrel roll. §eS§r: air brake.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power menu / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (crystal in hand): switch power.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.kryptonian_cry: Amethyst shards in the corners, diamonds on top and bottom, gold ingots on the sides and a sunflower in the center. Put on the suit and stand in the sunlight to charge it.
